profile.type: desktop GUI (Tauri/Rust/Svelte) + CLI/agent (Bash) security tool; light data-collection pipeline
profile.stack: Bash + jq (agent); Rust/Tauri v2 (desktop backend); Svelte 5 + Vite 6 + TypeScript (frontend); npm + cargo; bats + shellcheck + gitleaks
